rows.text: I finally learned how to phase through walls! Now, I too am a priest of the {RUBY_B#Janus}"twin doors"{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Phasefly

rows.text: How are you embedded in there?
Hehe, this is the wall-phasing technique. But my current position isn't great. Let me move a bit.
rows.speaker: Phasefly

rows.text: I can only see your wings stick out.
I—I just started learning this technique! Let me move around a bit...
rows.speaker: Phasefly

rows.text: Phew~ Alright, we're through the wall now.
rows.speaker: Phasefly

rows.text: Let me tell you a secret: The "twin doors" aren't just two doors, but endless doors! I've only seen three so far though...
rows.speaker: Phasefly
